description: This file defines the HorizontalNoOverflowStackPanel class, a custom UI panel for layout management in a Windows UWP application, prioritizing the last item in layout.

classes.name: HorizontalNoOverflowStackPanel
classes.description: A custom panel that arranges child elements horizontally, with special handling to prioritize the last item.

methods.name: HorizontalNoOverflowStackPanel
methods.description: Constructor for the custom panel, internal access modifier.

methods.name: MeasureOverride
methods.description: Overrides the measurement logic to determine the desired size based on children.

methods.name: ArrangeOverride
methods.description: Overrides the arrangement logic to position child elements horizontally, with prioritization of the last item.

methods.name: ShouldPrioritizeLastItem
methods.description: Virtual method that determines whether to prioritize the last item during layout; defaults to false.
